data.message: All 24 others: opt in individually to 18 tons—not an all-or-nothing deal. I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, risking next stock of 100; this isn't guaranteed best long-term. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
